notes.title: Desert Race Adventures Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Vroom-vroom!

The demo for Desert Race Adventures is now out and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3777220/Desert_Race_Adventures_Demo/"]available for everyone to try[/url]. [/p][p]Take it for a spin, and make sure to let us know what you think by leaving a review!  [/p]

notes.title: Desert Race Adventures Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p]Hey, racers! Start your engines!
[/p][p]We are about to release the Desert Race Adventures demo on Steam [i]very soon[/i]. You can take the game for a test drive and (maybe 👀) add it to your wishlist.[/p][p]With the demo, you’ll have access to a portion of the rally route that will be available in the full game. Start your adventure in Brussels and ride on across Europe to Morocco, through wild terrain, sandstorms and who knows what else?[/p][p][/p][p]Keep your eyes on the road and don’t miss the launch announcement soon![/p]
